Unlock the perks of being an Ampliteer

Competitive pay and benefits packages reflect our commitment to the overall health and well-being of our team.

We offer parental leave for birthing and non-birthing parents in accordance with local leave policies (may vary by country); Carrot fertility benefits, adoption, and surrogacy support; and back-up childcare support.

We offer flexible vacation time—and encourage our employees to use it!

We provide a monthly Lifestyle Spending Account for wellness activities and other lifestyle expenses. Examples include gym memberships, fitness classes, massages, phone and internet expenses, and pet adoption fees.

Our quarterly L&D stipend empowers self-initiated learning for professional development and growth.

We offer no-cost employee access to Modern Health coaching and therapy sessions for employees globally.

In addition to offering competitive RSU grants that vest quarterly over three years for eligible employees, our Employee Stock Purchase Plan gives employees the option to buy below market price.

We offer medical, dental, and vision insurance coverage for our employees and their dependents.
